notes.title: Build 0.360 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Inventory and Mastery Visual Changes[/h3]

The graphics in the inventory and mastery panels have been upgraded to reduce visual clutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/bcc6bdeb6e783f40155a14fa72125af159c509c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/f14fa4bf016e28b0c535d51b4f78c222d225b3c0.png[/img]

The mastery panel has also gained a card viewer. Clicking the cards now zooms in on them, so you can view the description in a more readable size, as well as view the artwork in a larger size. Popups still work in the viewer, so you can hover the cards to display the descriptions of keywords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/97b750ac4c54b6a3858efcdcd82088d76e541a8d.png[/img]

[h3]Talent Visual Revamp[/h3]

The talents button has been replaced with one that's more in line with the discard and draw pile buttons, and it also shows how many talents are active in total. The very first talent you play in a run will automatically open the talent panel, which you can toggle with the button.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the Merchants event not calculating Torches correctly and not letting players choose certain options 
[*] Fixed the Chasm event not calculating Scrap correctly and not letting players choose certain options
[*] Stealth description has been updated to better reflect how it works
[*] Fixed an issue with the Matriarch, where after her death the joint power ability was still present for the other enemies
[*] Fixed an issue with The Undertaker, where it was possible for him to be damaged by boons or talents
[*] Fixed an issue with the Protection floating text display, where an extra 0 appeared
[*] Fixed an issue with the heal number floating text on the Crossroad, where multiple heal numbers overlapped each other
[*] Fixed an issue with the Sturdy Brute action display, where the attack action showed an incorrect damage number
[/list]

The next major update is expected to introduce a new mainhand weapon: the Pistol, featuring new abilities and a wide range of new cards.

We continuously seek out and fix bugs, and we appreciate your reports! Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the new update.

notes.title: Build 0.352 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In the most recent update, we focused mainly on the Mastery points for balance, but the Milestones also add a bit of an extra challenge.

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]New Feature: Milestones[/h3]

We've added new milestones to the game, which reward the player with some extra bloodshards for the following:
 
[list]
[*] Defeating a Boss in a victorious run
[*] Defeating an Elite in a victorious run
[*] Completing a successful run (per region)
[*] Clearing a region
[/list]

The successfully surpassed Milestones are distinctively marked on the map, and they are also showcased at the end of successful battles when the player receives the reward.

[h3]Mastery Changes[/h3]

The base amount of mastery points a player gains at the end of a run has been increased.

If an equipped item reaches the maximum amount of mastery points, any excess will be distributed among the player's other equipped gear.

[h3]Armor Behavior[/h3]

Armor damage calculation has been updated - from now on, the Diamond boon and Splint mail upgrade also reduces the damage the armor would take.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Ruthlessness not stacking
[*] Fixed an issue with Debilitating Stab not applying the correct amount of weakness
[*] Fixed an issue with Cobra Strike not counting every dot correctly on the enemy
[*] Fixed an issue with the settings menu in the HQ not being able to use the dropdown menus
[*] Fixed an issue where the character portrait in the Inventory didn't update after changing appearance in the mirror
[*] Various localization fixes
[*] Fixed the Dagger achievements getting checked at every startup
[/list]

Join the Discord server of the Monastery and never miss out on the news from the shadow realm!

notes.title: Build 0.351 Patch Notes - New Mechanic and other updates
notes.notes:
[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]New Mechanic: Brittle[/h3]

We're introducing the [b]Brittle [/b]mechanic with this update; Brittle cards have a 50% chance of getting removed from the battle after being played. You will find this keyword on some starting cards if you take a dagger into battle.

[h3]Scry Update[/h3]

The Scry feature has been updated to work better in different scenarios. From now on, as long as the player hasn't used it in a turn and has torches, they can use scry as long as they have at least one card in their draw and discard piles (combined) and have space in their hand.

In case the player has the Guidance boon with them in battle, but only has space in their hand for two cards, they'll be able to choose which two cards to draw out of the three.

[h3]Card Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] Double-Stab has been renamed to Stab and no longer has Multistrike, instead deals 6 damage.
[*] All Ballock Knife and Parrying Dagger starting cards have become Brittle
[*] Weak Spot now deals 5 damage, and applies Poison 1 and Vulnerability 5 for every 2 Combo points lost (instead of 2-2)
[/list]

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]

[list]
[*] Animated elite and boss previews have been added to the map
[*] A new filtering option has been added to the iventory for trinkets that only shows the ones that are compatible with the player's equipped items
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Shield Throw, where the second target was at the last position and died to the attack
[*] Fixed an issue with action icon update on The Undertaker, and general DOT handling
[*] The Iron Cannon's projectile vfx has been updated

[*] Fixed an issue where cards with execute property could target bosses or elites

notes.title: The Dagger Update
notes.notes:
Build 0.350 for Monastery is now available! This update introduces Dagger variants, various visual upgrades, bug fixes, and improvements. Check out the details in the release notes below.
On behalf of the teams at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and for providing valuable feedback to help us improve the game!

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Combo[/b]: Playing a card generates 1 Combo. Combo resets at the start of your turn. Cards that consume combo don't generate any.
[*][b]Finishing Move[/b]: At the end of the turn a Finishing move is performed to the direction the player is facing.
[*][b]Momentum[/b]: Every card played earlier in the turn grants a card using this mechanic a bonus.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Daggers[/h3]

[b]Ballock Knife[/b]: Finishing Move deals 1 damage for every 4 Combo. Begin each battle in Stealth and with +1 Stamina.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/49abc9af0ee776a15badff4ab5f88137d27c1fb4.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Fast Knife
[*] Black Knife
[*] Smoke Knife
[/list]

[b]Throwing Dagger[/b]: Finishing Move applies Poison for every 5 Combo.
[list]
[*] Poisoned Dagger
[*] Sharp Dagger
[*] Devil Dagger
[/list]

[b]Parrying Dagger[/b]: Finishing move deals 1 damage for every 4 Combo. You have 3% Block for every Combo.
[list]
[*] Safe Dagger
[*] Rogue Dagger
[*] Long Dagger
[/list]

[h3]New Cards[/h3]

47 new cards have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/8dfb9aa0dff7bb7791d50c91ded469e0a29a49fa.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Boons[/h3]

[list]
[*] Dice
[*] Snake
[*] Spine
[*] Cheetah
[*] Hole
[*] Phantasm
[*] Haste
[*] Ferocity
[*] Fall
[*] Hurricane
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/26a2604d5f8400c86c6f410f492ce8d3135ab08b.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Achievements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Reach Master of Balock Knife level 5.
[*] Reach Master of Throwing Dagger level 5.
[*] Reach Master of Parrying Dagger level 5.
[*] Max out all your Dagger Masteries.
[*] Obtain all Balock Knives.
[*] Obtain all Throwing Daggers.
[*] Obtain all Parrying Daggers.
[*] Eliminate 3 enemies with one Finishing Move.
[/list]

[h2]General Improvements and Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Miner King’s start-of-turn ability has been fixed — the player now draws one less card, since the scrap card is added at the beginning of each turn.
[*] The Miner King’s start-of-turn popup has been updated.
[*] Descriptions in the Hydra Panel popup have been reworked.
[*] The Pummel card no longer incorrectly retains bonuses after being played.
[*] At the start of battles, the game now displays whether the encounter is Elite or Boss if applicable.
[*] The Map Run Preview has been updated — you can now track the status of other bosses alongside the selected one.
[*] New elite variation images have been added to both the map and battles.
[*] Fixed an issue with panel handling for Machine Bosses, ensuring no errors occur when they gain charges at the start of a battle.
[*] The maximum value for Master of XY has been set to 5. (e.g. Master of Broadsword)
[*] Fixed the damage display for Attack cards on the enemy HP bar — it now correctly includes Power and Weakness modifiers.
[*] The Berserker Stance has been fixed — it now correctly removes Protection.
[*] The Cave Bear’s sub-action icon has been fixed and no longer greys out while still Immortal.
[*] The Iron Cannon explosion VFX timing has been updated.
[*] Upon Player Defeat, the Exit to Menu/Exit to Desktop buttons are now disabled to prevent premature exits.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Tutorial where pressing the Abandon button would cause the game to freeze.
[*] The Abandon button has been updated in battles; it can no longer be clicked during defeat/victory screens or while it’s the enemy’s turn.
[*] The Killed by text has been removed from the end battle stats if the run was abandoned.
[*] Fixed the Abandon Banner position when the camera shifts due to a large number of enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

Defeating the last enemy sometimes doesn't end the battle.

[h2]Plans for Upcoming Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Crossroads Visual Upgrade[/b]: Events will receive a visual enhancement. Event options will include illustrations.
[*][b]Collection Update[/b]: Unlockable bonus for collected items
[*][b]Pistol Content Update[/b]: A new pistol item will be developed, featuring new abilities and a wide range of new cards.
[*][b]Controller Support[/b]: Full controller functionality will be implemented.
[*][b]Swamp Map and Enemies[/b]: A new swamp area and its associated enemies will be introduced, completing the 4th region.
[/list]

We continuously seek out and fix bugs, and we appreciate your reports! Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the new update.

notes.notes:
Build 0.389 of Monastery is now available! This update introduces a map overhaul, various visual upgrades and some other improvements, along with bug fixes. On behalf of the team at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and providing valuable feedback!

[h2]Map Overhaul[/h2]
The map has undergone a complete visual and functional overhaul. Bosses can now be selected in different areas. Once a boss has been chosen, the progress in that area will continue until that boss has been defeated. Elites are randomized but indicated in advance, and by clicking on the scroll icon next to a boss or elite portrait, you can read more about that specific enemy.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/41b827ed37c96f73478da2d25b58b5e333d89059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/69276fe9a89e1efc180c0523432f40c9fcef8e72.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/a6dc62183069803778ed0b72926f7908fa1c562d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/2007ff35aeef1cee3f1512a047d7357175ac271c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/9ac5a81f8303e10b40c3cee376d59861fc9aafdb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/df71e2465bcc1b7d9163674790d520c3ec696d01.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/0e6138c0a77336f7ea94c0be0f89b738c34dddf2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/5e3aa242077f56586aab19b6a8edb388b5c38653.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
This update introduces optimizations to asset loading, improving RAM and VRAM usage.

[h2]Game Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Difficulty can now be changed by clicking on the mirror at the headquarters.
[*] Corruption growth has been slowed down on easy and medium difficulty levels, making early progression significantly easier.
[*] Players will now be rewarded at the end of failed runs. These rewards will be randomized based on which stage the player failed on. In the future, rewards will possibly be given after abandoned runs as well.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing animation and the damage indication on Puker's death
[*] Fixed the camera not following the Undertaker
[*] Step doesn't work on the Undertaker anymore
[*] Fixed the tutorial difficulty setting
[*] Fixed certain issues with enemy action icons
[*] Fixed items being locked in the shop in new savefiles
[*] Ravager doesn't lose its bonuses anymore after being played
[*] Backing Blows is now affected by protection
[*] Card randomization has been updated, fixing the issue of cards sometimes not being added to the deck after receiving rewards on the Crossroads or at the start of the battle
[*] Duplicated cards sometimes not actually adding a duplicate has been fixed
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thorns damage popup has been added
[*] The descriptions of Tracking, Diamond boon and Splint Mail upgrades have been updated
[*] Disburden now draws Armor cards
[*] Various font and visual updates in the HQ and on the mastery panel
[/list]

[h2]Known/Possible Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Walker summoning event effects might cause issues with the Screamer
[*] Shortcut Crossroads reward might cause issues in the last battle
[*] Twins might cause issues when getting resurrected
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update: Map Overhaul & Optimization Progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We'd like to share some important updates regarding the development of the game.

[h2]Map overhaul[/h2]
We're currently hard at work on the visual and functional overhaul of the map. One of the most exciting changes is that bosses will now be selectable by area. When you choose a region, you'll instantly see the bosses there and decide which one you'd like to face. Once you've selected your opponent, it will remain available until you defeat it. Get ready, as strategy and skill will be crucial!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/39f8a7e8362b342d59d15a9e51de27ad6015bab2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/1901f12fee35f7d5483345ea44bb43dd7b500792.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/81c29c5a489c2b79301f306370713db5ff1edb53.png[/img]

[h2]Elite Visual Update[/h2]
At the same time, the elites are also getting a makeover. They’ll return with a fresher, more impressive look, making the battles even more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/29979e09e79602fbe79c362a83ff1b636faa1d36.jpg[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
In the background, we are continuously fine-tuning the game. Expect a significant reduction in VRAM/RAM usage and faster loading times with the upcoming updates. We’re doing everything we can to make the experience even smoother!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We've managed to address several bugs, and the testing of these fixes is currently underway. Thank you for your patience and for consistently reporting bugs!

[h2]New Content Incoming[/h2]
Last but not least, a new weapon, the dagger, is in the works, which will come with 40+ cards, new equipment, upgrades, and boons. We’re also further refining the loot system to give you even more options for character development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/4064775018202df8629e12f9bf489e81ea6259d9.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/185a315c480e20505849bd48e4404559136497ca.png[/img]

We are incredibly grateful for your feedback and continuous support. We’re working hard to fix as many bugs as possible and provide the best gaming experience. Every idea, bug report, and constructive criticism helps us in this, so please keep them coming!

Thank you for being with us on this journey!

notes.title: The Medium Armor Update
notes.notes:
Build 0.349 for Monastery is now available! This update introduces medium armor variants, various visual upgrades, bug fixes, and improvements. Check out the details in the release notes below.
On behalf of the teams at Lycan Studio, thank you all for playing Monastery and for providing valuable feedback to help us improve the game!

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Medium Armor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Thickened Brigandine
[*] Hardened Brigandine
[*] Sable Brigandine
[*] Red Leather Armor
[*] Black Leather Armor
[*] Grey Leather Armor
[*] Hide Armor of the Night
[*] Hide Armor of the North
[*] Hide Armor of the Wild
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e338cf74b4cd4dad1a98c85336d0d79333592ffc.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Cards[/h3]

28 new cards have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/1d92b24a5819e7f2b697b65711b0a84a02901bd3.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Boons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Petal
[*] Wood
[*] Dirt
[*] Footstep
[*] Rain
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/143a5bce36e9b7d4923bcd31d54b5cc5ac5ac9a4.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]Brew[/h3]

Gain a random Potion card, or upgrade an existing one if you have any.
[olist]
[*] If you don't have a Potion in your hand, you receive a random Potion I.
[*] If you have Potion I in your hand, it upgrades to Potion II (same type).
[*] If you have Potion II in your hand, it upgrades to Potion III (same type).
[*] If you have Potion III in your hand, you receive a different type of Potion I.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] You will receive a Potion you don't already have if possible. If you have all types, you get a random one.
[*] Potions are retained in your hand between turns.
[*] If your hand is full, you lose the chance to get a Potion.
[*] Potions are single use and not part of the deck.
[/list]
[h3]Step[/h3]

Move through the first enemy on the chosen side. That enemy shifts to the first position on the other side.

[h3]Stealth[/h3]

Your melee single target attacks can target any unit and ignore Taunt. You can't have Armor while in Stealth. Stacking Stealth will grant your next single target attack +2 damage.

[h3]Poison[/h3]

Poison deals 1 damage per stack at the start of turn. There is a 50% chance of Poison stacks doubling at the start of every turn.

[h2]Visual and Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Ghoul and Wolf Elite Color Variations[/h3]

Elite Ghouls and Wolves now have distinct color variations, making them visually distinguishable based on their abilities.

[h3]Raider Bonus Shard[/h3]

When fighting Raiders, you receive a bloodshard reward based on the battle they appeared in. This bloodshard reward is granted immediately, regardless of how far you progress or if the run is successful.

[h3]Difficulty-Based Extra Shard[/h3]

At the end of a run, you receive an extra shard based on the difficulty level.

[h3]Trinket Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trinkets now have item requirements. You can only equip them if you also have the required item.
[*] Trinket tags have been updated and trinkets now have different mastery requirements
[*][b] IMPORTANT:[/b] If you previously purchased a trinket that has a different mastery requirement now, it will appear as locked in your inventory. You will be able to use that trinket when you reach the said mastery requirement.
[/list]
[h3]Redesigned Crossroads Visuals[/h3]

Redesigned crossroads have been added to all areas. Additionally, the routes of the crossroads will change slightly during the run to add visual variety.

[h2]General Improvements and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated protection action icon above enemies.
[*] Titan ability now has an icon indicating it gains thorns.
[*] Stealth stance now has a stacking icon, showing the bonus damage under the player.
[*] Extra action effect icon above enemies grays out if the player is immune to that effect.
[*] Enemy action icon grays out if it would apply an effect the player is immune to.
[*] Card drag can now be interrupted with the ESC key.
[*] Scry popup changes if you can no longer scry in that turn.
[*] HP values for Brigand and Rogue enemies have been adjusted.
[*] Shield throw now selects a new target if the first one is not damaged.
[*] Guard stance now allows power application.
[*] Burden boon now affects Leak, increasing its value.
[*] Game speed display updated to 1x, 2x, and 3x.
[*] Berserker stance bug fixed where crit chance increase was not removed properly.
[*] Automaton action now updates correctly when an enemy switches sides.
[*] Hydra Prototype Zero now has the Swift ability, indicating its attack cannot be blocked.
[*] Inventory category expansion added, and the selected item's category will be expanded upon entry.
[*] Enemy action icon above the head is now hoverable.
[*] Fixed Adaptation reward on Crossroads giving random item upgrade instead
[*] Chapel event options 1 and 2 now give stamina and focus upgrades that last until the end of the run
[*] Barricade enemy now has the Stable ability.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game may freeze during the enemy's turn and not switch back to the player's turn, only resolved by ending the hunt.
[*] The game may freeze upon winning the last round with the shield throw card, which first takes out a non-boss and then the boss.
[*] Cards may get stuck during excessive brewing.
[/list]

We continuously seek out and fix bugs, and we appreciate your reports! Thank you, and we hope you enjoy the new update.

notes.title: Build 0.347.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Build 0.347.7 for Monastery is available now. This update contains an overhaul of the bosses found in The Mines, various visual upgrades, bug fixes and improvements to the user interface. Check out the details in the release notes below.


[h2]Automatic Error Reporting[/h2]
We have added an automatic error reporting feature to the game, to help us find problematic errors more easily. It’s an opt-in feature, which players can turn on or off on the new privacy policy panel. This was added because there are certain errors that are very hard to reproduce manually. We hope this will help us improve the quality of the game going forward.

[h2]Boss Overhaul[/h2]

[h3]Miner King[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gives Taunt to a machine in the first position at the start of the turn
[*] Action chances have been removed and the Miner King's actions now chang sequentially

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/c8976834ac6e602faea9aa61161e465630026ce5.png[/img]

[*] New boss panel, that shows the current state of Malfunction, Overload, and how the Hydra's attack is changed based on the Shock the player transfers to it
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/86db0706dc45fe9cf23d08d3cb2a992920f8c767.png[/img]

[h3]Titan[/h3]
[list]
[*] New boss panel that shows the Titan's charge state
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/cfd0fe7fbc7e5d7f227dc752cd9b94071d270204.png[/img]

[h3]General Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Small tweaks to Machine waves

[*] Enemy name moved to popup
[*] Shock can be transferred to enemies now
[*] General popup layout and positioning fix

notes.title: The Mines Update - Build 0.347 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Our team is delighted to announce that a major update, The Mines, is now out and available!
[/h3]

But what exactly does this mean for you, heroes of the Monastery?
The Mines is a menacing new area that provides way to the Monastery, but it does not make survival easier. It is just as dangerous as it seems!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e143dc75a8b380829733ca62e31f5d6d7e65e09d.png[/img]
The enemies found in the depths of the Mines are stronger than those you've encountered before. Fittingly to the theme, they are machines and their operators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/e4733fd3b2f9be237917526c172f4de15af61386.png[/img]
These new enemies are going to be working together to take you down, buffing each other along the way by Charging and Loading each other, causing explosions, Shocking the player, and much more. Along with various the common enemies, the update contains 3 new bosses, as well 9 new elites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/234c54d95130fa142054fadd648dc6feae58a594.png[/img]
A new mechanic is also present in the update: the Mines-exclusive Scrap system. Scrap can be collected from fallen machines and can either be played as cards in battle, or used as currency at the Crossroads; you'll be able to trade your scrap for various rewards or passive buffs as part of the many new events you can encounter after every battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616794/b52488ad302b60b4c374cb0684f7a323e7afff1f.png[/img]

This is only the beginning of what we have in store, so stay tuned!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new area has been added to the game: the Mines, complete with new visuals in both battle and the Crossroads
[*] A new enemy type has been added to the game: machines
[*] 15 new Crossroads events
[*] Scrap system; gain Scrap after defeating fallen machines and play them as cards or spend them as currency at the Crossroads
[*] New visual effects
[*] New status effect icons
[*] 9 new tracks to accompany the player in the Mines
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Crossroads has been updated with more feedback panels that display what the player got as rewards
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the Pack event effect not working
[*] Fixed the Shelter event option 1 giving torches when it shouldn't have
[*] Fixed path discovery at the Crossroads when player only had 1 Torch 
[/list]
